section.heading: ## Lists (proteinjs ui) — a scrolling list adjusts its position once it has been still
section.text: - A list that loads more rows as you scroll adjusts its position once it has been still for 150 ms with no finger on it.
smoke: - In a long list that loads earlier rows as you scroll up, flick, then catch the list with a finger and hold a second before lifting: the rows stay where your finger stopped them.
- In a long windowed list, scroll far down and press its scroll-to-top button once: the list reaches the top.
